day.headline: A Monkey day — Rat and Dragon are in step.

reasons: Dragon and Monkey share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Grab the new hire for coffee before someone duller does.

reasons: Snake pairs with Monkey — a harmonious day
signs.message: Still sealed since whenever. Open it, use an obscene amount.

reasons: Rabbit sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: You built that lunch and left it home. Go get it.

reasons: Ox sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a notification you keep swiping away
signs.message: Fourth swipe today. Open it, do the thing, forget it.

reasons: Rat and Monkey share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: a lift you decided not to take
signs.message: Turning down that ride means you get your podcast. Fine trade.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: The cilantro's slime again. Chop what's left tonight, no guilt.

reasons: Rooster sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a street you have never turned down
signs.message: Turn left where you always go straight. Five minutes, that's all.

reasons: Pig sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: sitting down to think and not thinking
signs.message: You sat down to think and thought nothing. Still counts.

reasons: Monkey's own day — your energy runs high
signs.motif: the feed you know is bad for you
signs.message: You know which app sours the whole day. Skip it entirely.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the last one on the shelf
signs.message: Someone else can have the last one. You didn't need it.

reasons: Tiger opposes Monkey — a day to take slowly
signs.message: You make your sibling sound boring. Just don't bring them up today.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Someone paid and never mentioned it. Sorting that out can wait.
